Title: Pearl Port
Text: Pearl Port is a bustling island city known for its rich boba and tea culture. Built along the southern coast of a largely uncharted island, it serves as both a trade hub and a frontier town for explorers. Though modern in parts, many areas remain rooted in tradition.

Title: History of Pearl Port
Text: Founded over a century ago by a coalition of pioneering families, Pearl Port was established during a boom in boba and tea farming. Over time, the Kim family rose to prominence for their contributions to exploration and commerce. The city's expansion has always been tied to the taming of the island.

Title: Pearl Port Unexplored Territories
Text: Large portions of the island remain uncharted and are rumored to be inhabited by unknown creatures and ancient ruins. These regions are perilous, and all official expeditions are overseen by the Kim family. Only the bravest citizens venture beyond the borders.

Title: Kim Boba Shop
Text: Located in the heart of Pearl City, this popular shop is more than a business — it’s a cultural landmark. Run by the Kim family, it’s known for blending traditional and experimental flavors. Travelers often make it their first stop after docking at Pearl Port.

Title: The Kim Family
Text: One of Pearl Port’s founding families, the Kims have long been leaders in both governance and exploration. They run the city’s most successful boba shop and fund most expeditions into the wild interior. Locals revere them, though some whisper that their influence may hide deeper secrets.
